# checker

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/internal/checker"
```

Package checker proves structural immutability from Go compiler type information. It follows Go's structural type predicates and checks each component. Frozen type obligations form a graph; definite failures propagate to owners. A recursive collection is accepted only when every reachable obligation holds.

## Constants

LibraryPath is the package whose sealed collection implementations are trusted.

```go
const LibraryPath = "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/im"
```

RuntimePath is the package whose supervised service runtime is trusted.

```go
const RuntimePath = "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/supervise"
```

ServiceMarker identifies supervise.Service, the generic type embedded by services.

```go
const ServiceMarker = "Service"
```

## func Contains

```go
func Contains(t types.Type) bool
```

Contains reports values that need im source checks, including their holders and containers. It runs one query; use Classifier to reuse results across queries.

## func Copied

```go

```

Copied reports the presence of an embedded im.Copied value, not type validity.

## type Classifier

Classifier caches protected storage, callback, and service reference queries for one analysis pass. Its zero value is ready for use. Types must not change after their first query. A Classifier must not be used by concurrent passes.

```go
type Classifier struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func \(\*Classifier\) Callable

```go
func (c *Classifier) Callable(t types.Type) bool
```

Callable reports whether t contains a callback contract that carries protected storage.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Contains

```go
func (c *Classifier) Contains(t types.Type) bool
```

Contains reports values that need im source checks, including their holders and containers. Frozen pointer handles and Copied records use ordinary Go storage rules.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Handles

```go
func (c *Classifier) Handles(t types.Type) bool
```

Handles reports whether storage or a callable contract contains a service reference.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Locals

```go
func (c *Classifier) Locals(t types.Type) bool
```

Locals reports local projections or records in storage, including through arrays and pointers.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Owns

```go
func (c *Classifier) Owns(t types.Type) bool
```

Owns reports protected object storage, including its holders and containers. Frozen handles can occupy ordinary mutable slots without changing their targets.

### func \(\*Classifier\) Transport

```go
func (c *Classifier) Transport(t types.Type) bool
```

Transport reports values that need restricted calls, bindings, and captures. Frozen values and pointers can persist. Local values and protected native container uses stay restricted.

## type Failure

Failure contains a rejected rule and the repair supplied by that rule. An empty Reason means that the proof passed.

```go
type Failure struct {
    Reason string
    Repair string
}
```

## type Prover

Prover reuses immutable type obligations within one analysis pass. Its zero value is ready for use. Types must be complete and must not change. A Prover must not be used by concurrent passes.

```go
type Prover struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func \(\*Prover\) CopiedFailure

```go
func (p *Prover) CopiedFailure(t types.Type) Failure
```

CopiedFailure returns the failed type rule and its repair from the same proof.

### func \(\*Prover\) CopiedReason

```go
func (p *Prover) CopiedReason(t types.Type) string
```

CopiedReason proves bool, numbers, Copied records, unnamed arrays, or opaque service references.

### func \(\*Prover\) Failure

```go
func (p *Prover) Failure(t types.Type) Failure
```

Failure returns the failed storage rule and its repair from the same proof.

### func \(\*Prover\) FrozenFailure

```go
func (p *Prover) FrozenFailure(t types.Type) Failure
```

FrozenFailure returns the failed type rule and its repair from the same proof.

### func \(\*Prover\) FrozenReason

```go
func (p *Prover) FrozenReason(t types.Type) string
```

FrozenReason proves the shared payload contract used by Cell and Projection.

### func \(\*Prover\) ReadResultFailure

```go
func (p *Prover) ReadResultFailure(t types.Type) Failure
```

ReadResultFailure returns the failed type rule and its repair from the same proof.

### func \(\*Prover\) ReadResultReason

```go
func (p *Prover) ReadResultReason(t types.Type) string
```

ReadResultReason proves Copied values, local values, and unchecked handles through one type rule.

### func \(\*Prover\) Reason

```go
func (p *Prover) Reason(t types.Type) string
```

Reason proves t or returns a component path to a failure. The selected cause can depend on earlier queries; each root message is cached.
